fields.name: site
fields.label: Site

options.notes: From useEnvData (useEnvData.ts:34-41). mapLocationOptions encodes the value as 'dcim-location:["<location_type>","<id>"]' when location_type is present (location-options.ts:21-36). location_type is a repeated static query param.

fields.query_param_normalization: Resolved against loaded locations by encoded value, provider id, or display name (resolveLocationFormValue); unresolvable value clears site and device (workflow.tsx:228-246).
client_only_validation: UI-only field, required: trimmed min 1 'Site is required' (workflow.tsx:41)
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted; it only filters the device option query (site and site_type).

fields.name: tenant
fields.label: Tenant (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('tenant')), empty strings dropped (workflow.tsx:167-170). Filtered to values in the loaded options (workflow.tsx:279-288).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each value is sent as a repeated 'tenant' query param on the device option request (workflow.tsx:206-218).

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status (optional)
fields.query_param_normalization: Multi-value (getAll('status')), empty strings dropped (workflow.tsx:171-174). Filtered to values in the loaded options (workflow.tsx:291-300).
fields.submit_transform: Not submitted. Each value is sent as a repeated 'status' query param on the device option request (workflow.tsx:209-218).

fields.name: device_id
fields.label: Device
fields.schema_description: Identifier of the network switch to upgrade.

options.notes: There is no platform filter (switchosupgradeworkflow/form/page.tsx:46-49 passes no deviceFilterParams). tenant/status arrays are sent as repeated params, and site_type is decoded from the encoded site value (useDevices.ts:42-50). There is no request until site is set. All depended-on fields are UI-only.

fields.query_param_normalization: Kept only if present in the loaded device options, otherwise cleared (workflow.tsx:248-262).
fields.submit_transform: UI form field 'device' is renamed to 'device_id' (page.tsx:32-34).

payload_transform: onSubmit (switchosupgradeworkflow/form/page.tsx:30-43) POSTs {"device_id": data.device} to /v1/workflow/ngc/switch_os_upgrade through startWorkflow (utils.tsx:153-183). site, tenant and status are filter-only. commit_confirm (DeviceWorkflowForm state, default true) is not rendered and not sent.
discrepancies: The schema has a single required device_id (os_upgrade.py:83-87). The UI also requires a UI-only Site and offers Tenant/Status filters, none of which are submitted.

The workflow supports only Cumulus Linux and Juniper JunOS and rejects other platforms at runtime (SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS os_upgrade.py:73, check at :177-184). The UI offers every managed device with no platform filter.

The spec runs the shared tests with defaultPlatform 'Arista EOS' and the comment 'Switch OS upgrades work primarily with Arista devices' (switchOsUpgradeForm.spec.ts:27-31). That contradicts SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS.
Label 'Device' differs from schema title 'Device Id'.
contract_gaps: The UI-only site/tenant/status filter fields have no schema properties, so they must be internal to device_reference, whose filter set v1 does not specify.
depends_on maps one query param to one sibling field. Here tenant/status are arrays sent as repeated params, and site_type is derived from the selected site option's location_type.
The location option source needs the repeated static param location_type=Site&location_type=Module, but OptionSource.params is scalar-only.
